download_cc100_corpus: download the CC100 corpus to an output directory using multiprocessing for parallel shard extraction
download_cc100_snapshot: download a specific CC100 snapshot like 2018-51 with all 500 shards to a directory
download_cc100_shard: download and split a single CC100 shard into per-language gzip text files
iterate_cc100_paragraphs: iterate over Paragraph named tuples with language, text, and language model score from a shard
split_paragraphs_by_language: split an iterator of paragraphs into per-language gzip files in an output directory
